title: The Well-Tempered Clavier, Book 2, Fugue 5 in D major

character.text: Canzona or verset-type black-note fugue, worked in stretto

sections.label: Episode 1
sections.summary: Reworks the codetta (bar 4) in part, with the alto's line in the tenor, the tenor's line in the bass, at the same pitch level. Soprano: free counterpoint. Alto: a figure from the subject. Tenor: a figure from the subject (2 times), in a sequence falling by a fourth every half bar. Bass: a figure from the subject (2 times). Returns in Episode 2 (bar 13).
sections.leads: From A major to E minor

sections.label: Episode 2
sections.summary: Reworks Episode 1 (bars 7–9) in part, with the alto's line in the soprano, a step higher. Soprano: a figure from the subject (2 times), in a sequence rising by a fourth every half bar. Tenor: free counterpoint. Bass: free counterpoint. Returns in Episode 6 (bars 35–39).
sections.leads: From B minor to A major

sections.label: Stretto: Subject in A major (Alto); Subject in D major (Soprano)
Episode 3
sections.summary: Reworks the codetta (bar 4), with the alto's line in the bass, at the same pitch level. Soprano: a figure from the subject (3 times), in a sequence falling by a fourth every bar. Alto: a figure from the subject (3 times). Tenor: a figure from the subject (3 times), in a sequence rising by a fourth every half bar. Bass: a figure from the subject (3 times), in a sequence rising by a fourth every half bar. Returns in Episode 4 (bar 24).
sections.leads: From D major to B minor; perfect cadence in A major at bar 20

sections.label: Stretto: Subject in B minor (Tenor); Subject in B minor (Soprano); Subject in B minor (Alto)
Episode 4
sections.summary: Reworks Episode 3 (bars 16–20), with the soprano's line in the bass, the tenor's line in the alto, the bass's line in the tenor, the lines moved by different intervals (invertible counterpoint at the twelfth). Soprano: free counterpoint. Alto: a figure from the subject. Tenor: a figure from the subject. Bass: free counterpoint. Returns in Episode 5 (bars 29–32). Returns in Episode 7 (bars 41–44).
sections.leads: From B minor to F♯ minor

sections.label: Link
sections.summary: Free counterpoint: nothing here is traced to the themes.
sections.leads: From F♯ minor to A major; perfect cadence in F♯ minor at bar 27

sections.label: Stretto: Subject in A major (Bass); Subject in A major (Soprano)
Episode 5
sections.summary: Reworks Episode 4 (bar 24), with the alto's line in the soprano, the tenor's line in the alto, the lines moved by different intervals (invertible counterpoint at the tenth). Soprano: a figure from the subject (2 times). Alto: a figure from the subject (3 times), in a sequence falling by a step every half bar. Tenor: a figure from the subject (2 times). Bass: a figure from the subject (3 times).
sections.leads: From A major to D major

sections.label: Stretto: Subject in D major (Tenor); Subject in B minor (Alto); Subject in G major (Soprano)
Episode 6
sections.summary: Reworks Episode 2 (bar 13), with the soprano's line in the alto, the tenor's line in the soprano, the lines moved by different intervals (invertible counterpoint at the tenth). Soprano: a figure from the subject (4 times), in a sequence rising by a fourth every half bar. Alto: a figure from the subject (6 times), in a sequence rising by a step every bar. Tenor: a figure from the subject (2 times). Bass: a figure from the subject (3 times), in a sequence rising by a fourth every half bar.
sections.leads: From G major to D major

sections.label: Episode 7
sections.summary: Reworks Episode 4 (bar 24), with the alto's line in the soprano, the tenor's line in the bass, the bass's line in the alto, the lines moved by different intervals (invertible counterpoint at the twelfth). Soprano: a figure from the subject. Alto: free counterpoint. Tenor: a figure from the subject and the opening of the subject. Bass: a figure from the subject (2 times) and the opening of the subject.
sections.leads: From D major to A major

sections.label: Stretto: Subject in A major (Soprano); Subject in F♯ minor (Alto); Subject in D major (Tenor); Subject in B minor (Bass)
